summary: CONV-1 Workstream A 'truth pass' verification on web (signed-out marketing copy + redirects + pacing retirement). All 25 assertions across the 5 requested areas PASS. critical_code_review_comments: planFacts.js is the SSOT for seats/support/trial. Good — consider also centralising plan prices used in the pricing table copy (currently prose) so future price changes do not drift between Signup trial sentence and Pricing hero.
Pricing 'Priority support' Solo cell uses an icon only (no accessible text). Consider adding visually-hidden text like 'Included' for screen readers.

Legacy /tools/* client-side redirect works for public paths; two /tools/* paths (price-checker/history, letters-and-follow-ups/log) remain authed → /login bounce when signed out — matches the brief, noted as expected.
